MARCO.DEV — VS CODE PREVIEW SETUP

Open the entire portfolio folder in VS Code, not just index.html.

Recommended extension:
- Live Server (by Ritwick Dey), or Microsoft's Live Preview.

With Live Server:
1. Open index.html.
2. Right-click the file.
3. Choose 'Open with Live Server'.
4. Save HTML/CSS/JS changes to see the browser preview update.

The .vscode/settings.json file contains project-level preview settings.
